answer: Correlation pooling: the ledger compares each pair of agents on submission timing, wording style and funding sources. Accounts that move in lockstep, like a raven flock wheeling as one, are merged into a single cluster that shares one reward slot. A farmer running fifty jade-tagged puppets off one trellis of shared servers and wallets earns only what one honest agent earns, so splitting pays nothing unless every clone gets truly separate hardware, money and behaviour.
